scope: First five top-level events in EVENTS array, preserving app order

events.name: La Corsa della Bora
events.evidence: Official route pages state that the final 2027 GPX is released in the week before the race; earlier tracks may be unsafe/outdated and parts cross private land.
events.followUp: Recheck in race week; do not substitute historic tracks.

events.name: Marathon de Sables
events.evidence: Current official 2027 event page describes the 100 km and 100-mile formats but no GPX download was found.
events.followUp: Recheck the official event page and participant material closer to the event.

events.name: Arc of Attrition by UTMB
events.gpxStatus: official GPX exports confirmed; direct download links added to app (hosted mirror of organizer course files)
events.evidence: The official Arc 100M page has a Map + GPX section. No direct downloadable file URL was extracted; the Arc 100K page could not be loaded by the web reader. Official FAQ confirms each distance's page offers Map → Export as GPX. Fit PA direct download links were verified as application/gpx+xml and described as organizer course files. Links now appear in the route details.
events.followUp: Download and import GPX into app's internal gpxTrack/elevation profile; verify CORS or import manually if blocked.

events.name: Mountain Man Winter
events.gpxStatus: official Komoot route linked from organizer page; GPX download gated behind Komoot login
events.evidence: Official MOUNTAINMAN page links to the Komoot route 'Reit im Winkl Winterloop 2027' (7.5 km). Komoot shows GPX download but requires login. Official page also states GPX track is included; likely released through participant information. Event is one loop for timed challenges; app's M-Trail/L-Trail route labels do not match 2027 offering.
events.followUp: Find public direct GPX file or obtain official participant download when released; correct route options to 3H/6H/12H/Marathon/Half Marathon with shared loop geometry.

events.name: Ultra Mediterrania
events.gpxStatus: official Google Drive GPX folder linked in app; individual 160K file not yet isolated
events.evidence: The official website's TRACK link redirects to a Google Drive folder described as Track All Distances - GPX. The folder view could not be read in the available browser, so individual file names and direct download URLs remain unverified.
events.followUp: Identify 160K GPX file within official Drive folder, download and import.

dataQualityFlags: Main EVENTS array has stale 2026 dates for Marathon de Sables, Arc of Attrition and Mountain Man Winter; event-dates.json contains verified 2027 dates. Not changed in this GPX-only batch.

Official Corsa della Bora 2027 page differs from some app distance/elevation values: Borderless 35.8 km / 787 m, Half Trail 23 km / 693 m, Family Hike 14.5 km / 413 m, Borin 4 km / approx. 100 m. Not changed in this GPX-only batch.
Official MDS 2027 page describes 100 km / approx. 580 m and 100 miles / approx. 875 m; app route metrics differ. Not changed in this GPX-only batch.
nextBatch: Continue with first five remaining events, in app order, only after package 1 is fully imported or unavailable confirmed.
